extracted.intended_audience: Prospective applicants and awardees for U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science grants
extracted.subtask_short: applying for DOE Office of Science grants
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and submission guidance for preparing, submitting, and managing grant applications and awards under the U.S. DOE Office of Science. Focuses on required submission channels, points-of-contact, and where to find related program-specific funding information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required submission channel: Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant applications must be submitted through Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit applications via mail or email; follow Grants.gov procedures and use Grants.gov to apply for Office of Science grant opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not submit applications to Office email or mailing address
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not submit grant applications to this mailing or email address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact information for the Office of Sponsored Activities is provided for inquiries, but application packages must be submitted through Grants.gov. The page supplies the Office address and an email (sc.grantsandcontracts@science.doe.gov) for questions, not for application submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage grants with PAMS
rubrics_metrics.description: Manage grants with the Portfolio Analysis and Management System (PAMS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PAMS for post-award management activities as directed by the Office of Science; link provided on the Office of Sponsored Activities resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquisition and contracting services provided by ISC
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquisition and contracting services are provided by the DOE Office of Science Integrated Support Center (ISC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ISC is a virtual organization combining support capabilities in Chicago and Oak Ridge; applicants/awardees should coordinate acquisition/contracting matters with the ISC Office of Acquisition and Assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use appropriate DOE program office for non-Office-of-Science topics
rubrics_metrics.description: For subject areas outside the Office of Science (e.g., energy efficiency, fossil energy, ARPA‑E, nuclear energy, grid reliability), consult the corresponding DOE program offices/websites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs prospective applicants to other DOE sites: energy.gov/eere (energy efficiency/renewable energy), energy.gov/fe (fossil energy), arpa-e.energy.gov (ARPA‑E), energy.gov/ne (nuclear energy), and energy.gov/oe (power grid/electricity delivery/reliability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Office contact and inquiry routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information for the Office of Sponsored Activities and Office of Grants and Contracts Support is provided for questions regarding the grant process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists mailing address (U.S. Department of Energy, SC-43/Germantown Building, 1000 Independence Ave., SW, Washington, DC 20585) and an email (sc.grantsandcontracts@science.doe.gov). It emphasizes these are contacts for inquiries, not submission destinations.
